name: NeuDA
definition: NeuDA is a neural implicit surface reconstruction method that uses deformable anchors to encode local geometry. It shares a similar architecture with NeuS but replaces standard positional encoding with Hierarchical Positional Encoding (HPE) and uses a shallower SDF network (4 layers vs 8 for NeuS).
summary: NeuDA is a neural implicit surface reconstruction method using hierarchical deformable anchors and a shallower network to achieve high-fidelity, sharper surfaces with lower computational cost than NeuS.
